evidence_items.explanation: Supports the LLM portion: these models repeatedly supplied nonexistent scholarly sources. It does not measure healthy-human fabrication or establish an overall conversational rate.

The researchers classified 35% of participants as reporting a false childhood memory. This challenges a sweeping dismissal of human fabrication, but the experiment supplied misinformation and measured memories and beliefs rather than ordinary spontaneous invention.

This later reanalysis cautions against treating the earlier experiment's headline rate as a rate of confident, wholly invented memories. It supplies neither an everyday human base rate nor a matched LLM comparison.
